title: Dataset Import Formats
content: The demo platform accepts CSV, JSONL, and TSV files when importing datasets. Import formats describe how data enters the system, not how datasets are exported.

title: Report Export Options
content: Evaluation reports can be exported as CSV or JSON files. Report exports contain aggregate metrics, timestamps, and evaluation summaries rather than the original dataset export configuration.

title: Uploaded Dataset Retention
content: Uploaded temporary datasets are retained for 30 days by default. This retention policy applies to temporary uploaded files, not completed benchmark results.

title: Audit Log Retention
content: Administrative audit logs are retained for 90 days. Audit logs record workspace activity and are managed separately from benchmark evaluation results.

title: API Request Rate Limits
content: The demo API allows a maximum of 500 requests per hour for a standard workspace. This request rate limit is separate from the number of prompts allowed in an evaluation batch.

title: Prompt Template Length
content: Individual prompt templates may contain up to 500 characters. This limit controls the length of each template, not the number of prompts in an evaluation batch.

title: Knowledge Base Document Limit
content: A knowledge base can contain up to 500 documents in the standard workspace. This is a storage limit and does not specify the maximum number of prompts per evaluation batch.

title: API Key Rotation Policy
content: Workspace administrators should rotate API keys every 90 days and revoke keys that are no longer needed. This policy describes credential maintenance rather than where API keys are stored.

title: Token Usage Dashboard
content: The usage dashboard displays recorded input tokens, output tokens, and total token counts for each model request. It reports usage metrics but does not by itself calculate the final cost of an API request.

title: Model Pricing Reference
content: The model pricing reference lists configured input-token and output-token prices. Pricing values are used as configuration inputs for cost estimates and may change independently of recorded token usage.

title: Dataset Export Formats
content: The demo evaluation platform supports exporting datasets in CSV, JSONL, and Parquet formats.

title: Benchmark Result Retention
content: Benchmark results are retained for 90 days by default. A workspace owner may delete results sooner.

title: Evaluation Batch Limits
content: A single evaluation batch can contain a maximum of 500 prompts.

title: API Key Security
content: API keys must be stored on the server as environment variables. They must not be embedded in frontend code.

title: Model API Cost Estimation
content: Estimated model API costs are calculated using recorded input and output token usage and configured model pricing. The estimate is not a guaranteed billing total.

title: Evaluation API Request Timeout
content: The demo specification sets a 30-second timeout for each synchronous evaluation API request. Longer-running evaluation batches should be queued instead of blocking a synchronous request.

title: Temporary Failure Retry Policy
content: The demo specification allows up to three retries for temporary HTTP 429 rate-limit responses and HTTP 5xx server errors, using exponential backoff. Ordinary validation-related HTTP 4xx errors should not be retried.

title: Workspace Roles and Permissions
content: The demo workspace defines Owner, Admin, Annotator, and Viewer roles. Viewer is read-only and cannot change workspace settings or perform administrative actions.

title: Retrieval Metric Definitions
content: Precision@K measures the fraction of the top K retrieved documents that are relevant. Recall@K measures the fraction of expected relevant documents retrieved. Reciprocal rank at K is the reciprocal of the rank of the first relevant result within the top K, or zero if no relevant result appears. MRR@K is the mean reciprocal rank across benchmark questions.

title: JSONL Dataset Format and Encoding
content: A JSONL benchmark dataset must use UTF-8 encoding and contain one valid JSON object per non-empty line. The file should not wrap all records in a single JSON array. Each record should include the fields required by the benchmark schema.

title: Citation and Source ID Matching
content: An expected citation must exactly match a knowledge document's source_id field. A document title match alone does not replace the required source identifier.

title: Implemented Retrieval Methods
content: The current benchmark compares two lexical retrieval methods: TF-IDF with cosine similarity and BM25 ranking. Dense embedding retrieval is not currently included in the implemented comparison.

title: Sensitive Data in Evaluation Prompts
content: The demo specification requires direct personal identifiers to be masked or removed from test prompts before storage. Access to any retained sensitive evaluation data should be restricted.

title: Workspace Request Rate Limits
content: The demo specification sets a default limit of 60 requests per minute per workspace. Requests that exceed the limit receive HTTP 429. Clients should respect a Retry-After header when the service provides one. This per-minute limit is distinct from the hourly request allowance.

title: Model Version Tracking for Audits
content: For auditability, record the provider name, model identifier, and model version with each model evaluation run so results can be associated with the model configuration that produced them.

title: Reproducible Benchmark Runs
content: To reproduce a benchmark comparison, record the dataset version, knowledge-base snapshot, K value, retriever configuration, and relevant model versions. For stochastic components, record the random seed where applicable.

title: Retrieval Failure Classification
content: The failure analyzer classifies SUCCESS when an expected source is ranked first. RANKING_ERROR means an expected source appears in the retrieved results but not in first position. RETRIEVAL_MISS means none of the expected sources appears in the retrieved results.

title: Versioned API Route Prefix
content: The project's versioned API routes use the /api/v1 prefix to identify the first API version.

title: Benchmark K Parameter Limits
content: The benchmark run API accepts K values from 1 through 15 inclusive. K controls how many top retrieval results are evaluated.

title: Evaluation Run History Endpoint
content: The evaluation history API allows a limit from 1 to 100 records and returns the newest saved evaluation runs first. Each saved run has a unique run ID and includes configuration and evaluation summaries.
